Pre-Call Questionnaire

We're genuinely excited you're considering partnering with us for your celebration. This questionnaire helps us prepare for our conversation and ensures we're the right fit for each other.

Please complete this thoughtfully and fully - your responses help us understand your story, your values, and what matters most to you. We ask that you submit this at least 24 hours before our scheduled call in order to hold your consultation date and time.

Thank You!

We've received your questionnaire and look forward to our conversation about creating a celebration worthy of your journey.

Your Celebration Vision

Beach, mountains, specific country/region, still deciding, etc.
For Comprehensive Package: Minimum 32 guests to ensure celebrations that feel substantial and worthy of a destination experience. No minimum for Exploratory Package.
This is your estimated budget for the entire wedding - venue, catering, florals, photography, accommodations, etc. Our couples typically invest $800+ per guest for the celebration itself. The estimated range for 32-40 guests: $25,600-$32,000+

Investment & Decision Making

We offer two planning packages:

Exploratory Package - Starting at $1,500
Ideal for couples planning at all-inclusive resorts or venues with strong on-site coordination teams. Includes planning support, vendor curation, timeline creation, and guest experience design. We work closely with the resort team to ensure seamless execution, but we are not on-site for your wedding day.
Comprehensive Package - Starting at $5,000 + 10% of total celebration budget
Our signature high-touch service from vision to execution. Includes everything in Exploratory plus refined curation, full vendor management, detailed coordination, and on-site management of your entire wedding weekend.
If parents or others are involved in the hiring decision or covering costs, we kindly ask that they join our call. This ensures everyone is aligned and starts our partnership on solid ground.
